## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-05

- First version: Aiwyn Tax (formerly Column Tax) remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint taken from the Claude connector directory listing for Aiwyn Tax (formerly Column Tax).
- The auth mode is none: the server returned a tool list to an anonymous request. No tool was called.
